visual_review: Screenshots produced by headless chromium and inspected with vision after the run. Two defects found and fixed before the final run: (1) the 'exact official file' badge stretched across the row (CSS specificity, now inline-block), (2) runtime overhead rendered as 0.000 GiB for an unknown quantity (now an em dash). Final renders: single-column at 360px with no clipping, ledger rows aligned, validation notices visible and readable.
limits: No GPU/runtime measurement was performed anywhere: gpu_runtime_checked is false by design and stated in CLI, page, README and docs.
The ledger models only full uniform attention with fp16/bf16 KV. MoE, MLA, sliding windows, hybrid per-layer attention, quantized KV and partial offload are refused.
Tensor parallel replication, CUDA graphs, paged-attention block padding, prefix caching and tokenizer/server overhead are not modelled.
Context is capped at each config's max_position_embeddings (Qwen2.5-7B: 32768). Qwen2.5 YaRN/rope extrapolation to 131072 is not modelled, although the model card mentions it.
Qwen3-8B publishes no official q4_0/q3_k_m/q2_k GGUF, so those quants are refused and only available as a labelled bytes/parameter estimate (CLI --allow-estimate; not exposed in the UI).

Firefox UI verification is pending: the sandbox /usr/bin/firefox is not Playwright-drivable. CI installs the Playwright firefox build and runs the same suite there; this phase's browser evidence is chromium only.
Telegram share only opens the official t.me/share/url chooser. No message was posted, no external write was performed, and none was verified.
GitHub Pages content and deployment are NOT updated: index.html is regenerated in the repo but not pushed; publication needs parent approval and a readback of the deployed page.
spec_gaps: Contract output #1 (planning/baseline_20261107.md + asset_inventory.json with live 62 subscribers and bot inventory) is outside this worker's P0-03..06 scope and was not produced here.
Contract output #8 (updating active_backlog.json with truthful task states) is the parent's durable-backlog duty; this worker only reports its own evidence.

Bench still needs at least one real provider run to demonstrate a non-null tps; local fake-server tests prove the usage path but do not measure real hardware (no provider call was made in this phase).
Qwen2.5-7B 'fp16' weights reuse the bf16 safetensors byte sum (same 2 bytes/parameter); the JSON labels this explicitly as official_safetensors_size_equivalent rather than a separate fp16 repository.
UI does not expose the estimate path, KV dtype beyond fp16/bf16, or multi-model comparison; deliberately out of this phase.
No external distribution (Show and Tell / awesome-list PR) was attempted: the contract gates those on a verified release and parent approval.
